snippet_primary: "For individual Creators residing in Mexico, Hotmart, acting as a reseller, will be responsible for issuing invoices to the Buyers, as well as issuing a self-invoice to the Creators. Notwithstanding the foregoing, such Creators remain responsible for all other tax obligations in their country of residence."
subject_exact: Hotmart as reseller issuing buyer invoices and creator self-invoices for individual creators residing in Mexico
